title: Indian Navy Agniveer SSR 2026: Eligibility, Exam and Training
metaDescription: Complete guide to Indian Navy Agniveer SSR recruitment 2026: age and education eligibility, written exam pattern, physical fitness test, medical standards
headline: Indian Navy Agniveer SSR: 2026 Recruitment Guide

sections.title: Who Can Apply for Agniveer SSR
sections.content:
The Senior Secondary Recruit scheme is open to unmarried male and female Indian citizens who have passed Class 12 with Mathematics and Physics, along with one of Chemistry, Biology or Computer Science. Candidates must be between seventeen and a half and twenty-one years old on the date specified in the official notification.

Final-year students and candidates awaiting results are generally not eligible unless the notification says otherwise, so applicants should read the current advertisement carefully. The scheme recruits sailors for a wide range of branches, including operations, technical, logistics and administrative roles.

sections.title: Written Exam and Selection Stages
sections.content:
Selection begins with an online computer-based written examination covering English, Science, Mathematics and General Awareness, with objective-type questions and negative marking for wrong answers. Candidates who clear the written test are shortlisted for the physical fitness test and a preliminary medical examination.

Shortlisted candidates then attend a final enrolment medical examination at designated military hospitals, followed by document verification and police verification. A merit list is prepared from the combined performance, and selected candidates receive joining instructions for training.

sections.title: Physical Fitness and Medical Standards
sections.content:
The physical fitness test for male candidates generally includes a 1.6 kilometre run, squats and push-ups within set time limits, while female candidates have adjusted standards for the same events. Regular running, bodyweight training and a balanced diet are the most reliable ways to prepare.

Medical standards cover vision, hearing, dental health, height, weight and general fitness, with minimum height requirements that vary by region and category. Candidates with tattoos, certain medical conditions or uncorrected vision problems should check the detailed standards before applying.

sections.title: Training, Pay and Career After Service
sections.content:
Selected Agniveers train at INS Chilka in Odisha, where they learn naval discipline, drill, swimming, weapon handling, seamanship and service subjects over several months. After basic training, sailors are allotted branches and sent for professional training before joining ships and establishments.

Agniveers serve for four years with a monthly package that rises over the term, plus allowances and a Seva Nidhi corpus on completion, partly funded by the government. Up to twenty-five percent may be retained for permanent enrolment on merit, while others leave with a certificate, skills and priority in several government and private-sector roles.

faqs.q: What is the age limit for Navy Agniveer SSR 2026?
faqs.a: Candidates must be between seventeen and a half and twenty-one years old on the date specified in the official notification for that batch. Age is calculated strictly against the notified cut-off date, and no relaxation is generally available beyond what the official advertisement states for that recruitment cycle.

faqs.q: What education is required for Agniveer SSR?
faqs.a: Applicants must have passed Class 12 with Mathematics and Physics, along with one of Chemistry, Biology or Computer Science from a recognised board. Candidates awaiting final results are generally not eligible unless the current notification explicitly permits them to apply.

faqs.q: What is the Navy Agniveer SSR exam pattern?
faqs.a: The selection begins with an online computer-based test covering English, Science, Mathematics and General Awareness, with objective questions and negative marking for wrong answers. Candidates who clear the written test proceed to the physical fitness test, medical examination and document verification stages.

faqs.q: How long is Agniveer service and what happens afterwards?
faqs.a: Agniveers serve for four years with a monthly package that rises over the term, plus allowances and a Seva Nidhi corpus on completion, partly funded by the government. Up to twenty-five percent may be retained for permanent enrolment on merit, while others leave with a certificate and priority in several other roles.
